name: mamekit
description: Knowledge-graph-first transpiler: MAME driver source -> runnable browser (canvas) emulator app

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:current && npm run test:blast-radius
scripts.test:unit: tsc --noEmit && find src -name '*.spec.ts' -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -P "${SPEC_JOBS:-4}" -I{} sh -c 'node "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $1"; exit 255; }' _ {} && echo "all colocated specs passed"
scripts.test:current: npm run gen:all && npm run audit:generated
scripts.test:games: for game in $(node src/games/acceptance.ts --list); do node src/games/acceptance.ts "$game" || exit 1; sleep 5; done
scripts.test:games:record: for game in $(node src/games/acceptance.ts --list); do node src/games/record-goldens.ts "$game" || exit 1; sleep 5; done
